facts.label: Cold Snap rank 1 of 1
facts.value: Finishes the remaining cooldown on all your other Frost spells.

facts.label: Fingers of Frost (Frost)
facts.value: Fingers of Frost has 2 ranks and sits on row 5, column 3 of the Frost tree. It requires Ice Lance.

facts.label: Fingers of Frost rank 1 of 2
facts.value: Gives your Chill effects a 15% chance to grant you the Fingers of Frost effect, which treats your next 1 spell cast as if the target were Frozen. Lasts 15 sec.

facts.label: Fingers of Frost rank 2 of 2
facts.value: Gives your Chill effects a 15% chance to grant you the Fingers of Frost effect, which treats your next 2 spells cast as if the target were Frozen. Lasts 15 sec.

facts.label: Winter's Chill (Frost)
facts.value: Winter's Chill has 5 ranks and sits on row 6, column 3 of the Frost tree.

facts.label: Winter's Chill rank 1 of 5
facts.value: Gives your Frostbolt and Fingers of Frost empowered Ice Lance spells a 20% chance to apply Winter's Chill, increasing the target's damage taken from your next Cone of Cold by 20% and it gains an additional 7% of your spell damage, stacking up to 5 times.

facts.label: Winter's Chill rank 2 of 5
facts.value: Gives your Frostbolt and Fingers of Frost empowered Ice Lance spells a 40% chance to apply Winter's Chill, increasing the target's damage taken from your next Cone of Cold by 20% and it gains an additional 7% of your spell damage, stacking up to 5 times.

facts.label: Winter's Chill rank 3 of 5
facts.value: Gives your Frostbolt and Fingers of Frost empowered Ice Lance spells a 60% chance to apply Winter's Chill, increasing the target's damage taken from your next Cone of Cold by 20% and it gains an additional 7% of your spell damage, stacking up to 5 times.

facts.label: Winter's Chill rank 4 of 5
facts.value: Gives your Frostbolt and Fingers of Frost empowered Ice Lance spells a 80% chance to apply Winter's Chill, increasing the target's damage taken from your next Cone of Cold by 20% and it gains an additional 7% of your spell damage, stacking up to 5 times.

facts.label: Winter's Chill rank 5 of 5
facts.value: Gives your Frostbolt and Fingers of Frost empowered Ice Lance spells a 100% chance to apply Winter's Chill, increasing the target's damage taken from your next Cone of Cold by 20% and it gains an additional 7% of your spell damage, stacking up to 5 times.

facts.label: Ice Barrier (Frost)
facts.value: Ice Barrier has 1 rank and sits on row 7, column 2 of the Frost tree. It requires Cold Snap. In use: 305 Mana, Instant, 30 sec cooldown.

facts.label: Ice Barrier rank 1 of 1
facts.value: Shield yourself, absorbing 447 damage and increasing your Frost damage by 15% for 1 min. While shielded, your Frost damage is increased by an additional 5% and you do not lose casting time when you take damage.
